title: When the Hollow Turns
author: Cyrus Oyelaran
blurb: Rosalind Sterling, an exiled storm-caller, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
